mapper.select: SELECT * FROM forum_categories ORDER BY sort_order ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO forum_categories (name, description, sort_order, topic_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{sortOrder}, #{topicCount}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE forum_categories SET topic_count = topic_count + #{delta} WHERE id = #{id}
